Following up — Elena from TalentBridge also confirmed Alex is open to a 2-week delayed start and prefers a role that includes mentorship. I asked for a short written preference and she said she'll push it to me today.

Proposal (my recommendation):
- Offer with manager-backed 30/60/90 ramp plan focusing on async batching + production KV patterns.
- Compensation: market mid (discuss with TA), no counter required immediately.
- Final owner: Vivek to coordinate hiring manager + compensation; Marissa to drive offer packet and TA loop; Tessa to run a quick culture check tomorrow if needed.

If no objections, Vivek can confirm and I'll start paperwork.

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Consensus reached: move forward with an offer, contingent on the manager signing the ramp plan. Action owners:

- Vivek (owner): coordinate with hiring manager (K. Patel) on ramp plan and sign-off; confirm compensation band with TA.
- Marissa (owner): prepare offer packet and DocuSign; target send by Tuesday 7/21.
- Tessa (owner): run the culture/manager fit check tomorrow AM; send a 1-paragraph write-up to Marissa.
- Jonas: support technical onboarding plan and provide mentor contact.

I cc'd Elena so TA has the updated timeline; Alex, appreciate your flexibility on start date — Elena will share his written preference and we will confirm in the offer.

I’ll close the loop once DocuSign is out. Thanks team.
